title: Backcasting from 'Lab Safety Teams Are Adequately Staffed': An Open-Source Headcount/Org Signal Analysis

original_idea.body:
# Backcasting from 'Lab Safety Teams Are Adequately Staffed': An Open-Source Headcount/Org Signal Analysis

**Problem:** A success state where labs can credibly deliver on safety commitments requires sufficient safety-team capacity. The Index relies on disclosed processes, but the underlying organizational capacity (safety headcount, retention, seniority) is opaque and rarely quantified from public signals.

**Direction:** Build a public-signal proxy for safety-team capacity across labs: count safety-relevant roles from public job boards/LinkedIn-style public listings, safety-authored paper counts, and public departures/announcements over time. Combine into a transparent capacity index with clear caveats, and compare it against AI Safety Index grades to test whether disclosed processes track underlying capacity.

**Why it matters:** Backcasting from 'commitments are deliverable' shows organizational capacity as a hidden precondition behind paper commitments. A public-signal capacity proxy adds a dimension the Index lacks (FR67 'additional dimensions'). All public-signal data — outsiders can assemble this where labs won't.

**Relevant context:** FLI AI Safety Index dimensions (FR67: apply to additional dimensions); public reporting on safety-team departures at frontier labs (2023-2025); MIRI strategic-landscape agenda on org dynamics.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Vague impact: a noisy headcount proxy has only a loose, indirect link to actual safety outcomes.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Assembling public-signal counts; accessible but data-collection heavy, no compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused capacity-index deliverable, though noisy multi-source data collection.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public-signal data outsiders can assemble where labs won't.

novelty.reasoning: A public-signal safety-capacity proxy index appears partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A public-signal safety-capacity proxy may be partly open.
